title: T3.1: Add story session-start CLI command — outputs JSON with systemMessage containing compact CLI reference + project state; handles missing/disabled project; special character safety; under 2s; new tests in session_start.rs

text:
Acceptance: story session-start (when .storyhook/ exists, plugin enabled) outputs valid JSON with "systemMessage" string containing compact CLI reference + project state (open count, ready count, next story info); under 4000 chars. story session-start (no .storyhook/) outputs {}. story session-start (plugin disabled) outputs {}. story session-start (no stories) outputs JSON with CLI reference and "0 open stories". Handles special characters in story titles without breaking JSON. Completes in under 2 seconds. New integration tests verify all scenarios.
Files: src/cli.rs, src/app.rs, src/help_topics.rs, tests/session_start.rs
